objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact in the system that contains company-wide regulations, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving processes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier composed of abbreviation, consecutive number, and title.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the document such as editing, creator, review, release, or released.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes effective, typically the release date.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number assigned to each released document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual textual or file-based content of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data that the document references.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT systems or applications relevant to or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies_or_areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scope of applicability indicating which organizational units or companies the document applies to.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the document management system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The function or responsibility of the user in the system such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: The access rights assigned to the user for specific documents or document types.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users grouped together for the purpose of assigning authorizations, distributing documents, and managing access rights.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the user group such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Archive.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: The intended use or function of the group in the document management workflow.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is attached to a main document and is automatically released with the main document, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment synchronized with the main document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment such as released or archived.

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Whether the attachment has been marked for archiving or archived.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not require dual control approval.

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information has been released or withdrawn.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to modify an existing document without altering the document version or affecting the main document's version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the change proposal such as created, scheduled for implementation, or completed.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person who created the change proposal.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: An automated workflow request created when a document approaches its validity expiration date and requires a validity extension check.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request in its workflow.

attributes.name: creation_trigger
attributes.description: Automatically created 30 days before the document's valid until date.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A workflow request created to invalidate a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request in its workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A workflow request created to re-validate a previously invalidated document and restore its authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request in its workflow.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users or user groups assigned to receive notification of document releases or to provide acknowledgement of documents.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution such as by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: Users or user groups included in the distribution list.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific user interface displaying documents relevant to the user based on their distribution list assignments.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of dashboard such as Reader Dashboard or Author Dashboard.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search function providing role-specific information about documents stored in the system.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of report such as Status Report or Search Report.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The user role for which the report is implemented.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a document that must be checked and released before becoming visible to readers in the corresponding language.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The primary language of the document before translation.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language to which the document is translated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the language version.

objs.name: organization_unit
objs.description: A structural entity within the company such as a department or location that can be referenced or assigned documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational unit.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents in the system for audit and governance purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the risk.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data in the system such as IT applications, companies, or organizational structure that can be linked to documents.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of master data such as IT Application or Organizational Structure.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: The action of creating a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: The action of modifying document content or properties after creation.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: The action of uploading an external file or document to a document object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: The action of entering or updating document properties such as attributes, references, and scope.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The automatic system action of converting a document to PDF format after content is saved.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: The action of assigning read or write permissions to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: The action of designating users to participate in the document release workflow as author, reviewer, or releaser.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: The action of initiating the three-step workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: The action of an electronic signature by a workflow participant to confirm completion of their workflow task.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: The action of a reviewer or releaser confirming their approval during the review or release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: The action of a reviewer or releaser rejecting a document during the review or release workflow step, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The action of the releaser finally approving and publishing a document to make it visible to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The automatic system action of publishing a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The automatic system action of creating a new editing version when a released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of an author creating a change proposal for a document without modifying the document itself.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of applying a scheduled change proposal to a document, which creates a new version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of documenting the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The automatic system action of creating a request for validity extension when a document reaches 30 days before expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The action of a releaser or the full release team confirming that a document remains valid for an additional period.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: The action of creating a new version of a document after determining it requires revision during a validity check.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: The action of a user with write access creating a request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The action of the releaser or full override team confirming that a document is invalid and must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: The action of withdrawing authorizations for a document following its invalidation, with the document remaining physically intact for a defined archive period.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The automatic system action of permanently deleting an archived document after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The action of a Business Admin creating a request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The action of confirming reactivation of an invalidated document and creating a new version with restored authorizations.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: The action of assigning users or user groups to a document's distribution list for notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The automatic system action of sending an email to users when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: The automatic system action of requesting users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: The action of a recipient confirming receipt and understanding of a document via workflow.

evts.name: generate_dashboard
evts.description: The automatic system action of populating user and role-specific dashboards with documents based on distribution list assignments.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: The action of producing a role-specific evaluation or search report of documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: The action of translating released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The action of a reviewer and releaser approving and releasing a translated version of a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: The action of attaching a controlled document to a main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: The action of marking an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: The action of attaching non-critical supplementary material to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: The action of removing additional information from a document.

o2o.description: A document can reference another document via the References attribute.
A document can have one or more attachments which are controlled documents released with the main document.
A document can have one or more additional information items that are not subject to the main document's release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A document can have one or more language versions that are translated from the original document.
A document is assigned a distribution list containing users or user groups to notify upon release.
A document's validity scope can be specific to certain organizational units via the Relevant Companies or Areas of Validity attribute.
A document can be linked to risks in the system for governance purposes.
A document can reference master data such as IT applications or organizational structure via its attributes.
Users are members of user groups which determine their roles and authorization levels in the system.
A validity extension request is linked to the document that requires a validity check.
An override request is created for a specific document to invalidate it.
A reactivation request specifies which invalidated document is to be re-validated.
